d: Bihar vidhan parishad sabhagar men somvar ko snatak aur shikshak nirvachan kshetr se navnirvachit 8 vidhan parshadon (MLC) ka shapath grahan samaroh aayojit kiya gaya. karyakari sabhapti ramabchan ray ne sabhi 8 navnirvachit sadasyon ko pad evan gopniyta ki shapath dilaee. is mauke par mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri aur neta pratipaksh tejasvi yadav sahit kaee pramukh neta maujud rahe. ullekhniy hai ki 16 navanbar ko 4 snatak aur 4 shikshak nirvachan kshetr ke vidhan parshadon ka karyakal samapt huaa tha. is chunav men JDU ne 1, RJD ne 2, BJP ne 2, nirdaliy ummidvaron ne 2 aur jan suraj ne 1…
